hook: This model knows when thoughts were planted

beats.say: A new paper shows a Qwen 32B model can detect when a concept was injected into its earlier context, and identify which one.
The model denies it in its answers, but logit lens analysis finds clear detection signals in the residual stream, fading in the final layers.
Telling the model accurately how AI introspection works boosts sensitivity from 0.3 to 39.9 percent, with only a 0.6 percent rise in false positives.
